title: Aliens 'taunting' US Navy with better UFO technology, claims ex-weapons designer
excerpt: A former US Department of War contractor who spent 12 years researching UFO and extraterrestrial phenomena has claimed aliens are real and are deliberately staging US Navy UFO encounters
content:
A former US Department of War contractor who spent 12 years researching UFO and extraterrestrial phenomena has claimed aliens are real and are deliberately staging US Navy UFO encounters

19:27, 23 Nov 2026Updated 19:34, 23 Nov 2026

A former government weapons designer has made the explosive claim that UFOs and extraterrestrials are not only real, but are deliberately goading the US military by flaunting their vastly superior technology. Gary Moshier, a former US Department of War contractor who specialised in developing cutting-edge military weapons, turned his attention to uncovering evidence of UFOs after switching careers to become an author.

‌

‌

Following 12 years of exhaustive research, Moshier reached the startling conclusion that reported UFO encounters, cattle mutilations, alien abductions and crop circles were all 'staged' events orchestrated by extraterrestrials with the sole intention of intimidating humanity.

‌

Speaking to the Daily Mail, Moshier said: "A lot of what we know about them I consider to be staged. Obviously, these Navy encounters are staged."

Article continues below

He drew particular attention to a November 2024 incident in the Pacific Ocean, where Navy pilots from the USS Nimitz were carrying out training exercises when they tracked multiple unidentified objects plummeting from 80,000 feet to sea level in under a second.

One of the pilots, Commander David Fravor, described a white, capsule-shaped craft, later nicknamed the 'Tic Tac,' which appeared to react intelligently to his fighter jet's movements before shooting out of sight at breathtaking speed.

"They challenge our Navy fighters, harass them, shadow them and get them into engagements. They basically demonstrate overwhelming technology, technical superiority. So, they're taunting us," Moshier explained.

‌

He further suggested that this incident, along with other jaw-dropping UFO encounters, was designed by aliens to send a chilling message that they are invested in keeping Earth habitable to support their aims of repopulating their species.

The Tic Tac footage and numerous other UFO recordings released by the military have never been verified as genuine extraterrestrial craft.

‌

The US government has also consistently stated that no physical evidence of alien life has ever been retrieved on Earth.

Despite the absence of concrete proof, Moshier, the author of 'They're Here: UFOs and Their Occupants,' insisted the evidence lay in the locations of many of these encounters, which no one outside of the military is meant to know about.

‌

The author revealed UFOs had been documented entering the Combat Air Patrol rendezvous point, a classified location where pilots meet up after completing a mission.

Moshier said he believed UFOs were essentially declaring: "We're the superior race. We know where you're going. We know where you're going to be in the future. Don't mess with us."

‌

He explained his research, carried out using existing evidence from years of documented UFO and extraterrestrial sightings, began to reveal a clear pattern, which he claimed suggested why aliens are here.

He said: "My opinion is that we're being visited by an alien race whose main agenda is repopulation of planet Earth. They're coming here to live and thrive here."

‌

The UFO researcher specifically highlighted a 1994 UFO sighting in Zimbabwe where 62 students witnessed silver-coloured objects descending from the sky.

Many of the witnesses reported encountering humanoid figures and receiving telepathic messages.

‌

"These kids were telling their stories. The usual story is that we're ruining planet Earth," Moshier said.

Moshier claimed the common 'thread' running through numerous areas of UFO research was that extraterrestrials appeared to be cautioning mankind about the destruction of our planet.

‌

"They're seen at nuclear sites of all types, weapons storage areas, weapon platforms, weapon processing plants, or nuclear processing plants," the researcher added.

He went on to speculate that cattle mutilation was yet another attempt by aliens to highlight the importance of looking after livestock, driven by their apparent concern over humanity's food supply.

‌

According to these whistleblowers, the mysterious craft possessed the extraordinary capability to both activate and deactivate the missiles entirely at will.

Despite lacking evidence from any personal experiences, Moshier asserted that extraterrestrials' concern for environmental protection harbours ulterior motives.
